result: If the last hidden layer’s feature matrix starts full-rank (σ_min = α₀ > 0) and three explicit conditions hold, GD on all layers of a deep ReLU net converges geometrically, Φ_k ≤ (1 − ηα₀²/8)^k Φ₀; this needs only one layer of width N (special init), N² or N³ (LeCun-type init), instead of Ω(N⁸) in every layer.
result_plain: Deep ReLU GD converges if last-layer features stay full rank; one wide layer of width N, N^2 or N^3 suffices.
